acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p stoa-transit passes; dns_auth_cache table exists after migration
description:
Add dns_auth_cache table to the transit DB schema, replacing the
previously-planned dkim_key_cache table with a unified table covering
all DNS authentication evidence types.

File: new migration in crates/transit/migrations/

SQL:
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dns_auth_cache (
    evidence_type TEXT    NOT NULL,
    domain        TEXT    NOT NULL,
    selector      TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    record_cid    TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    first_seen_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_seen_ms  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ttl_secs      INTEGER,
    algorithm     TEXT,
    key_bytes     BLOB,
    policy        TEXT,
    record_status TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
    PRIMARY KEY (evidence_type, domain, selector, record_cid)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dns_auth_cache_lookup
    ON dns_auth_cache (evidence_type, domain, selector);
```

evidence_type values: 'dkim', 'spf', 'dmarc', 'arc'
selector: DKIM/ARC signing selector; empty string for SPF/DMARC
record_cid: CID of raw TXT blob; empty string for tombstone rows
policy: raw policy string for SPF (v=spf1 ...) and DMARC (v=DMARC1 ...); NULL for DKIM/ARC
key_bytes: DER/raw public key bytes for DKIM/ARC; NULL for SPF/DMARC

Defensive rules: IF NOT EXISTS on all DDL; no data migration needed.
title: DB migration: dns_auth_cache table (DKIM, SPF, DMARC, ARC)
